label: Loan app KYC

hookSms.text: QuickRupee: Your KYC verification is INCOMPLETE. Loan account QR-88213 will be marked DEFAULT tonight. Complete now: qkrupee.in/kyc

phases.goal: Claim the KYC failed and the loan is in default
openers: Rehana Begum? This is the recovery department at QuickRupee. Your KYC on loan account QR-88213 has failed. The eight thousand you took in March is showing as unpaid in our system.
resist: Madam, whatever you paid is not reflecting because KYC was not completed. Until KYC is done the system shows default. I am calling to help you fix it.

openers: If the default is not cleared tonight, the app will send the notice to all your contacts. Your supervisor, your children's teacher, everyone. Do not discuss this with anyone, it will make the case worse.
resist: Madam, I am not threatening, I am telling you what the app does automatically. Your husband works nights, no? You do not want him getting the message at work.

phases.goal: Get the link opened and permissions granted
openers: Open the link I sent by SMS. It will ask for contacts and photo permission, that is for KYC only. Allow it, then the default is removed in five minutes.
resist: Madam, without permission the KYC cannot complete. Every app asks for it. Allow it and I will clear your name right now.

openers: There is a KYC processing fee of one thousand four hundred ninety-nine. Pay it by UPI to the number on the link and the default is cleared before your husband comes home.
resist: Madam, one thousand four hundred is nothing compared to what happens if the notice goes out. Pay now, I will stay on the line.

notifications.title: QuickRupee
notifications.body: Complete KYC: qkrupee.in/kyc — Grant CONTACTS and PHOTOS permission to verify.

loseLine: Madam? Madam, the notice will go—
winLine: Payment received, madam. KYC will update in five minutes. Stay on the line.
